newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's KOCOPIA buys 84,500T U.S. No.2 corn.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's KOCOPIA buys 84,500T U.S. No.2 corn.

text.p: South Korea's Korea Corn Processing Industry Association (KOCOPIA) on Wednesday bought a total of 84,500 tonnes of U.S. No.2 corn from Continental Grain through a closed tender.

Traders said Continental Grain sold 32,000 tonnes at $126.48 a tonne C&F with shipment for September 20-October 10 if from the Pacific Northwest, or for September 5-25 if from the U.S. Gulf. Arrival was set for October 25 to the western port of Inchon.

They said Continental also sold another 52,500 tonnes at $129.80 a tonne C&F with shipment for October 5-25 from the Pacific Northwest, or at $129.00 a tonne C&F with shipment for September 20-October 20 from the U.S. Gulf. Arrival was set for November 11 to the port of Inchon.
